approaches_tried.approach: Extract export/sqlite dates via grep -oP on the freshness helper's free-text rationale using ad hoc patterns
approaches_tried.reason: Replaced with explicit machine-parseable export_date=/sqlite_date= tokens added to zotero-export-freshness.sh's rationale (see Phase 4 deviation) for robustness

deviations.description: Store the resulting token and the compared dates (Phase 4 task list item 2)
deviations.reason: Rather than parsing free-form date substrings out of the helper's human-readable rationale text, zotero-export-freshness.sh (Phase 1 file) was extended to also emit explicit export_date=/sqlite_date= tokens in its rationale, computed unconditionally (including in the FRESHNESS_UNKNOWN branch, which previously short-circuited before computing the export's own reference date). This is a small addition to Phase 1's already-committed file, made during Phase 4 verification after discovering the live [STALE EXPORT - export: DATE, sqlite: DATE] acceptance format needed a reliable machine-readable source rather than fragile regex on prose.

The initial capture guard covered only the helper invocation itself; a forced-helper-failure live test revealed a second silent set -e/pipefail trap in the `grep -oP ... | head -1` date-extraction pipeline (grep exits 1 on no match, which pipefail propagates). Both EXPORT_DATE and SQLITE_DATE assignments were given their own `|| VAR=""` guards after this was caught live, not merely reasoned about.
